method: 30-minute real snapTrans-smooth process-tree idle sampler, 15-second requested interval; no forced GC; no UI input
limitations: This is idle runtime evidence only. Repeated native screenshot/real browser scrolling were blocked by Computer Use automatic review and not executed.
Process-tree sums include only current snapTrans descendants (WebView2/OCR/helpers), not other applications. Working-set sums can double-count shared pages and are not used here.
Cold startup and idle helper expiry affect early samples. This does not certify multi-hour active-use memory or absence of all leaks.
